title: Travelling with a pet on public transport in Poland
question: Can I take my pet on a bus or train in Poland?
short_answer: Yes, pets are allowed on most public transport in Poland. Small animals in a carrier usually travel free. Larger dogs need a ticket and a muzzle.
conditions: Small animals in a closed carrier (up to 50×40×30 cm): usually travel FREE on buses and trams
Dogs not in a carrier: require a reduced-fare ticket (bilet ulgowy) — typically 50% of normal fare
Dogs must be on a leash and wear a muzzle (kaganiec) on public transport
PKP Intercity trains: pets allowed, small animals in carrier free, dogs with ticket
Rules vary by city — check ZKM Gdańsk, ZTM Warsaw, or your local transport authority
Guide dogs always travel free — no carrier or muzzle required
exceptions: Some private bus lines (FlixBus, etc.) may not allow pets — check before booking
During peak hours some carriers advise against travelling with larger pets
Exotic animals, reptiles, or birds may require additional conditions
penalties: Travelling without a valid ticket for your pet: fine same as for humans (40–150 PLN)
Dog without muzzle or leash: fine up to 500 PLN from Straż Miejska
